stimulus:
Instructions

In this experiment, we will present you with several hypothetical rules, and with descriptions of people whose actions may or may not comply with these rules.

In each case, your task will be to decide whether a person's action complied with the rule or not.

This will be indicated by pressing either the e key or the i key on your keyboard (further instruction will follow).

Please try to make the decision as quickly as possible.

There will be 8 blocks in this experiment, each block consisting of one rule and several examples of behaviours that may or may not comply with the rule. After each block, you will have the opportunity to take a short break.

We expect the whole experiment to take around 10 minutes.

Before the actual experiment, there will be some practice trials to help you become familiar with the task.

Press any key to see further instructions.

In this experiment, we will present you with several hypothetical rules, and with descriptions of people whose actions may or may not comply with these rules.

In each case, your task will be to decide whether a person's action complied with the rule or not.

There will be 8 blocks in this experiment, each block consisting of one rule and several examples of behaviours that may or may not comply with the rule. After each block, you will have the opportunity to take a short break.

We expect the whole experiment to take around 10 minutes.

Before the actual experiment, there will be some practice trials to help you become familiar with the task.

Press any key to see further instructions.
